name: security
description: Essential security tools: Timeshift backups, KeePassXC password manager, GUFW firewall, GnuPG
_comment: Note: Timeshift, KeePassXC, GUFW/UFW firewall, and GnuPG are active defaults. Advanced tools (VeraCrypt, WireGuard, OpenVPN, Wireshark, Nmap, BorgBackup, AppArmor) are in 'optional_packages'.
